Capability Evolver 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Analyze agent runtime logs to detect error patterns, regressions, and inefficiencies.
- Generates structured improvement proposals to enhance agent reliability and performance.
- Provides deterministic, fast (sub-100ms) processing with zero external dependencies or LLMs.
- Supports analyze, evolve, and status actions for diagnosis, health scoring, and evolution planning.
- Designed for seamless integration with OpenClaw and other agent platforms.
